test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6925e8548430c8b10a72221c6403187ea0e6e58de37aef66bb103f094ef534e.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: Letter 'H' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and lastly changed with Dotted Circle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/448967c12bd143e10dd7d9ca9a0c8966300243ee8e8df9a8e79398f38b87833d.png] 

Step II: Letter 'O' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and changed with letter 'P'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f2c3fda7281a3ed11dba2273de23b4d6a74f31d14c1fccc94dbf602561f5ee1.png] 

Step III: Symbol 'Rectangle' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and changed with letter 'C'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3ad6830677006a0938e0b129d037c6c5101cdca90bedb3054e615114a22ba1dc.png] 

Step IV: Symbol '=' has shifting a place in clockwise direction in next images, and changed with Shaded Triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3be4664d7f0a105b4f25f52cc4be37b6e77b54b50e90d08ae0a2e8b39ad3d3d.png] 

So, the complete series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5d0b7f5210dc00de4df4314f2e1da3189ac7e629af7401bb19477201d830cbdf.png] 

So, 'Option 1' will replace the question mark.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
